slides.title: Gemini
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Gemini, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Gemini is Google's general-purpose AI model, available as a free web chat and inside Workspace (Docs, Gmail, Sheets).
It handles long documents, images, and live web grounding, and connects to your Google Drive.
The free tier covers most everyday tasks; paid unlocks the most capable models, larger context, and Workspace integration.
slides.narration: Gemini is Google's general-purpose AI model, available as a free web chat and inside Workspace (Docs, Gmail, Sheets). It handles long documents, images, and live web grounding, and connects to your Google Drive. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: draft a rubric inside Google Docs, summarize a 30-page district policy, or turn lesson notes into a parent newsletter
SMB owners: pull insights from a Sheet of monthly sales, draft vendor emails in Gmail, or analyze a scanned invoice
Community leaders: summarize a long meeting transcript, translate a flyer into Spanish, or fact-check a claim with live web grounding
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can draft a rubric inside Google Docs, summarize a 30-page district policy, or turn lesson notes into a parent newsletter; SMB owners can pull insights from a Sheet of monthly sales, draft vendor emails in Gmail, or analyze a scanned invoice; Community leaders can summarize a long meeting transcript, translate a flyer into Spanish, or fact-check a claim with live web grounding.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
